>junior dev at a mid startup
>wednesday morning 
>just want to push a minor bugfix to our php app today
>open laptop, check slack
>company group chat is an absolute warzone
>CTO typing in all caps about php2shell
>fucking php 
>whatever, server hasn't blown up yet, I just need to get my code in
>open gitlab to merge the PR
>forced emergency logout because of a critical gitlab security patch release
>fucking gitlab 
>pipeline fails because of some weird regex compiler bug
>spend 40 minutes fighting CI/CD
>i can just use AI to help debug
>fire up opencode
>api keys nuked because they were breached
>fucking opencode
>i’ll just get fresh LLM api keys from our corp proxy, LiteLLM
>it won’t connect? It’s down?
>look up LiteLLM news: supply chain compromise 
>fucking litellm 
>cold sweat forming
>slack alert: db connection error 
>check our database connection
>we host on TiDB Cloud
>they just announced a security breach, unauthorized access via stolen service account credentials, data copied
>fucking tidb cloud
>full panic attack incoming
>figure fuck it, just ship the container to Railway and go home
>open Railway dashboard
>bright red banner: "Security Disclosure: Rotate all environment variables immediately. All builds paused."
>fucking railway
>try to open the app URL in browser to see if anything is even working
⁠>NET::ERR_CERT_AUTHORITY_INVALID⁠
>eMudhra intermediate certificates compromised 
>4
>instantly untrusted by every major browser
>fucking emudhra 
>stare blankly at mac screen for 10min 
>random pop-up
>restarting in 10min to fix a critical vulnerability
>fucking macos 
>close laptop
>leave office
>never come back
